Wolfe Research believes $MU DRAM gross margins currently exceed 90%.

That matters because AI servers pull DRAM from two layers with HBM stacked on the GPU and high capacity DRAM feeding the whole node.

That gives demand two independent legs making this upcycle look more structural than the usual memory spike.

SK Hynix's 72% operating margin roughly matches $NVDA which means the company selling the memory is earning margins on par with the company selling the GPU it plugs into.

HBM has changed the memory cycle with SK Hynix holding ~60% share as Nvidia’s primary supplier and DRAM contract prices rising over 80% QoQ.
